drug_class: Programmed Death Ligand-1 (PD-L1) Inhibitor Monoclonal Antibody

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Immunosuppressive Herbs (e.g., astragalus, reishi in excessive amounts)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May counteract avelumab's immune-activating mechanism and reduce therapeutic efficacy in cancer immunotherapy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose immunosuppressive supplements; consult oncologist before use

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce hepatic enzymes affecting any concomitant medications metabolized by CYP450; potential for reduced drug levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; inform clinical team of all herbal supplement use

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics and Prebiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Gut microbiota composition affects immune response; may influence checkpoint inhibitor efficacy, though data is limited
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for changes in immune-related adverse events; maintain consistent use if already taking

caution_supplements.name: Antioxidant Supplements (Vitamin C, E, Selenium in excess)
caution_supplements.mechanism: High-dose antioxidants may theoretically reduce immune activation; clinical significance uncertain with avelumab
caution_supplements.action: Use standard dietary doses; avoid megadoses without oncologist approval

avoid_foods.name: No specific foods contraindicated
avoid_foods.mechanism: Avelumab is a monoclonal antibody with no food-drug interactions; however, malnutrition impairs immune function and treatment response
avoid_foods.action: Maintain adequate nutrition and hydration; discuss dietary concerns with oncology team

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Though avelumab is not CYP3A4-metabolized, patients may receive concomitant medications affected by grapefruit; exercise general caution
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; inform team of all concurrent medications

caution_foods.name: High-sodium and Processed Foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May exacerbate immune-related adverse events (e.g., hypertension, fluid retention); impacts overall immune homeostasis
caution_foods.action: Maintain heart-healthy diet; monitor blood pressure and fluid status

monitoring_notes: Avelumab is a monoclonal antibody with minimal direct drug metabolism; primary concerns involve immune checkpoint modulation and concomitant medication interactions. Monitor for immune-related adverse events (irAEs) including autoimmune phenomena, and ensure adequate nutritional and immune support throughout treatment.
